text_block_list.text:
After the break, I exchanged greetings
with Winning Ticket in the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Mornin'~!
Thanks for giving me yesterday off!
choice_data_list: Did you get a good rest?
Were you able to get some proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, looking perfect~!
Both body and heart are packed with full power!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, bam-bam, non-stop!
I'm gonna do my absolute best with training!
Winning Ticket seemed to have refreshed both her mind and body.
